data.title: Other protease inhibitors (lopinavir, atazanavir, indinavir, nelfinavir, saquinavir)
data.summary: Antivirals & ART · HIV protease inhibitors (PIs), usually boosted with ritonavir
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Antivirals & ART_

**Class:** HIV protease inhibitors (PIs), usually boosted with ritonavir

## Mechanism of action
- Block HIV protease → gag-pol polyproteins not cleaved → immature non-infectious virions

## Pharmacokinetics
- CYP3A4 substrates; ritonavir boosting raises levels (see ritonavir post)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Second-line ART in India: lopinavir/ritonavir (LPV/r) or atazanavir/ritonavir (ATV/r) with 2 NRTIs (and dolutegravir in some regimens)
- Children: LPV/r formulations (older guidance)
- Indinavir, nelfinavir, saquinavir: historical, now rarely used

## Dose & formulations
- LPV/r 400/100 mg twice daily; ATV/r 300/100 mg once daily with food

## Adverse effects
- Class: lipodystrophy (central fat accumulation, buffalo hump), dyslipidaemia, insulin resistance, GI upset
- Atazanavir: unconjugated hyperbilirubinaemia (jaundice, yellow eyes — benign, UGT1A1 inhibition), nephrolithiasis
- Indinavir: retinoid-like effects — paronychia, ingrown toenails, pyogenic granulomas, xerosis, cheilitis, alopecia; nephrolithiasis (drink plenty)
- Lopinavir: diarrhoea, PR/QT prolongation; nelfinavir: diarrhoea

## Contraindications
- With rifampicin (use rifabutin), simvastatin/lovastatin, ergot, oral midazolam, pimozide; PPIs with atazanavir

## Drug interactions
- As for ritonavir: inhaled/injected corticosteroids → Cushing syndrome; colchicine, cyclosporine, azoles

## Monitoring
- Lipids, glucose, LFT, bilirubin (atazanavir), renal function

## Pregnancy & lactation
LPV/r and ATV/r can be used in pregnancy.

## Viva points
- Indinavir → retinoid-like nail fold changes and pyogenic granuloma
- Atazanavir → benign jaundice
- PI lipodystrophy

_Sources: Khopkar ch.4 (Protease inhibitors); Wolverton 4e ch.11 and ch.67; current NACO ART guidelines. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
